boundaries: Pure in-memory codec of saved report and counterexamples derived from it; no learner imports/execution, predictions/scoring, acquisition, data/model payload read, resource probe or relaxed condition. Preserve numeric_trace_equality=null and full_replay_verified=false from failed attempt.
comparison: Canonical strict JSON bytes; finite floats only, signed 64-bit integers, string keys, no duplicate keys on load, no non-JSON objects, bounded depth/node/byte size. Reconstruct tuples from saved initial_pool lists only, with explicit provenance, never label reconstruction as a replay report.
normalization: Use exact type/layout template derived only from pinned saved report. Tuple/list interchange permitted only at /cases/{index}/arms/{arm}/initial_pool with saved non-null list; other tuples rejected. Object key order ignored, array order preserved. Never drop fields or coerce numeric/bool types; float comparisons exact, signed zero distinct. Missing/extra fields and differing types/lengths rejected.
stop: One static preflight and one fresh-process pure replay; exclusive artifacts. No old runner execute/replay calls, no success receipt in its namespace, no resumed consumed attempt. Passing codec checks never establish numeric replication or authorize a study.
